features.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
features.description: +4 STR, +2 CON, -2 INT, -2 WIS, -2 CHA

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium; global size effects are applied only once.

features.name: Type
features.description: monstrous humanoid (giant).

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: 30 ft land.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Begins speaking Common and Giant. Additional languages: Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Galkan, Giant, Goblin, Orc.

features.name: Hardy
features.description: +2 saves against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.

features.name: Natural Armor
features.description: +2 natural armor AC.

features.name: Powerful Build
features.description: Count one size larger only for favorable combat maneuver size calculations and size-based special attacks affecting you. True size stays Medium.

features.name: Stability
features.description: +4 CMD against bull rush or trip while grounded.

features.name: Imposing Figure
features.description: +2 Intimidate.

features.name: Slam
features.description: Natural slam 1d6 primary attack, secondary if wielding manufactured weapons.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Darkvision 60 feet.

features.name: Low-Light Vision
features.description: See twice as far in dim light.

features.name: Nightstalker
features.description: Ignore size Stealth penalties and gain +2 Stealth in shadowy light or natural darkness only.

features.name: Quick At Hand
features.description: Use improvised melee and thrown weapons without improvised-weapon penalty.

features.name: Fire Gigas Heritage Defense
